tools.name: get_api_credit_balance
tools.description: API credit balance: prepaid credits left for SEO data calls, amount spent, whether spending is suspended, and the per-call pricing rule. Free; no supplier call.

tools.name: check_google_maps_rankings
tools.description: Google Maps rankings: the local results for a keyword in a city, with rank, rating, review count, category and address, and the position of a given business. Costs API credits per call.

tools.name: get_google_business_profile
tools.description: Google Business Profile lookup: a business's Google profile with rating, review count, rating distribution, category, address, phone, website and whether it is claimed. Costs API credits per call.
